story_text: As a staff member, I want deleting a confirmed booking to return an error so that active reservations are protected.

positive.title: Deleting a confirmed booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add a booking Id of a confirmed booking
positive.expected_result: An error message stating that confirmed bookings can't be deleted

positive.title: Message clearly states the booking cannot be deleted
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add a booking Id of a confirmed booking
positive.expected_result: An error message stating that confirmed bookings can't be deleted

negative.title: Delete a deleted booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add a booking Id of a deleted booking
negative.expected_result: An error message stating that thid booking is already deleted

edge.title: Deleting a booking that was pending, then confirmed, then deleted
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid information
3. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
4. Add a booking Id of the created booking
6. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
7. Add a booking Id of a confirmed booking
edge.expected_result: An error message stating that confirmed bookings can't be deleted
